name: app.smartgenius/smartgenius
title: SmartGenius
description: Draft Instagram posts, carousels and stories, and draw images in your brand's style.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List the profiles in this Espaço. Call it first: every other tool that takes `profile` wants one of these. A profile with `hasInstagram: true` is an Instagram account and its `profile` is the @: posts and on-brand images are made for those. One with `hasInstagram: false` is a brand with no Instagram: its `profile` is only a name for it in SmartGenius, never an @. `blog` is the profile's blog (or null while it has none). Each profile is a brand, and a brand can post to more than one Instagram account or blog: list_brands lists them.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands in this Espaço and every place each one publishes to (`destinations`): its Instagram accounts (`connected`, `needsReconnect`) and its blogs (`url`, `state`), each with an `id`. A brand's `profile` is the profile list_profiles shows for it. When a brand has more than one Instagram account, create_post needs `instagram` with the id of the one you mean; with more than one blog, create_article needs `blogId`. Without it the call is refused with the choices and nothing is made. It only reads.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Make a new Instagram post, carousel, story or reel for a profile from an idea: SmartGenius plans it, writes every slide in the profile's voice, draws the images and writes the caption and hashtags. A reel (`format: reel`) is made of scenes, each with its narration: `seconds` is its limit, 30 or 60, and `slides` its scenes. This call makes the scenes, their narration and the caption. Its video is made only in the studio, at `studioUrl`, after a person confirms the narration there, and uses 1 more credit per started 30 seconds. No idea yet? Leave `idea` out and set `research: true`: SmartGenius picks the subject itself, the way Autopilot does, from the profile's saved ideas and what its daily research found in its niche, with that research's sourced facts. Without an idea and without `research: true` the call is refused. It answers at once, while the post is still being made. Call get_post with `wait` until `making.status` is `done` (a carousel takes a few minutes). Calling this again makes a second post and spends credits again, unless you send the same `requestId`: then you get the first post back. Costs one credit per newly generated image, caption included, not a fixed post fee. Text-only slides cost no credits. The post lands as a DRAFT in the studio: a person approves and publishes it there (`studioUrl`). `destination` says which Instagram account it is for; read it back with the `profile` this answer gives.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

instagram.description: The id of the brand's Instagram account it is for, from list_brands. Needed only when the brand has more than one

idea.description: What the post is about, in a sentence or a paragraph. Leave it out only with `research: true`

research.description: With no `idea`: let SmartGenius pick the subject from the profile's saved ideas and its daily research. With an idea, the post is about your idea

slides.description: A carousel's slides (default 5) or a reel's scenes (default 5 for 30 seconds, 10 for 60). A post or a story has one

seconds.description: Reel only: the video's limit, 30 or 60 seconds. Default 30

cta.description: What the reader should do next

links.description: Pages to read before planning (up to 5): an article, a product page

requestId.description: Any id you make up for this call, like a UUID. Send the same one if you retry after a timeout or a lost answer: you get the first answer back and nothing is spent twice. Remembered for 24 hours

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read one post: where it stands, every slide's text, the caption and hashtags, and the studio link. While it is still being made, pass `wait` (up to 50 seconds) and the answer comes as soon as it is done, or when the wait runs out with `making.status` still `queued` or `running`. A reel also has each scene's `narration` and its `video`: `standing` is missing (not made yet), behind (the video no longer matches the reel: a scene, the voice, the logo, the colors or the @ changed since it was made), current or failed. `tooLong` means the saved narration is estimated to run long in this voice or the take ran over its limit. The answer also gives the re-recordings still included. Only a person makes or updates the video, in the studio at `studioUrl`, after confirming the narration there; no call here makes it. Once the scenes are made, `making` can be a video take a person started there: a failed take shows in `video` too and is never a reason to call create_post again.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a post still being made

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Draw 1 to 4 images from a prompt. Without `profile` the prompt reaches the image model exactly as written, for anything, not only Instagram. With `profile` the image is drawn in that profile's look (its visual style and colours). Each newly generated image costs one credit from the Espaço's monthly quota; one that fails is not charged. Answers with a download link per image, valid for 7 days. Save the file if you need it longer. Pass a `requestId` so a retry after a timeout returns these images instead of drawing new ones.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

requestId.description: Any id you make up for this call, like a UUID. Send the same one if you retry after a timeout or a lost answer: you get the first answer back and nothing is spent twice. Remembered for 24 hours

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: How many credits this Espaço has used and has left this month, the daily ceiling, and when the month resets. Worth a look before making several posts or images in a row.

tools.name: create_article
tools.description: Write a blog article for a profile from an idea: SmartGenius researches the links you give, writes the article in the profile's voice and can draw a cover. No idea yet? Leave `idea` out and set `research: true`: SmartGenius picks the subject itself, the way the blog's own schedule does, from the profile's saved blog ideas and what its daily research found in its niche. Without an idea and without `research: true` the call is refused. It answers at once, while the article is still being written. Call get_article with `wait` until `making.status` is `succeeded` or `failed` (a few minutes). Costs 2 credits for the text, plus 1 more when `drawCover` is true. Calling this again makes a second article and spends credits again, unless you send the same `requestId`: then you get the first article back. The article lands as a DRAFT. You cannot approve or publish it: a person does that in the studio (`studioUrl`), or the profile's own blog schedule they already set. Give them that link. The profile must have a blog (see `blog` in list_profiles). When its brand has more than one blog, pass `blogId` (list_brands). `destination` says which blog it is for; read it back with the `profile` this answer gives.

idea.description: What the article is about. Leave it out only with `research: true`

links.description: Pages to read before writing (up to 3): a source, a product page

adFor.description: Set when the article is an ad for a brand: its name is shown to readers

language.description: One of pt-BR, en, es. Default: the profile's language

fromPostId.description: The id of a post on this profile to build the article from; its links come along

ideaId.description: The id of an idea saved on this profile's blog; it is used up

drawCover.description: Draw a cover image (1 more credit). Default false

research.description: With no `idea`: let SmartGenius pick the subject from the profile's saved blog ideas and its daily research. With an idea, the article is about your idea

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

blogId.description: The id of the blog it is for, from list_brands or list_profiles. Needed only when the brand has more than one blog. The call is refused if that blog was replaced since you read it

requestId.description: Any id you make up for this call, like a UUID. Send the same one if you retry after a timeout or a lost answer: you get the first answer back and nothing is spent twice. Remembered for 24 hours

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one article: where it stands, its title, dek and body, the link targets and the studio link. While it is still being written, pass `wait` (up to 50 seconds) and the answer comes as soon as it is done, or when the wait runs out with `making.status` still `queued` or `running`. It never writes anything.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

wait.description: Seconds to wait for an article still being written

tools.name: create_profile
tools.description: Make a new profile for a brand with no Instagram, and optionally its blog. It buys no article: it sets up the profile (name, short description, main colour) and, when you pass `blog`, the blog. Pass `links` (the brand's website, Instagram) and the profile takes its logo from them. Only an admin may call it. The profile counts against the plan's profile limit. Pass `blog.customHost` (like www.example.com or blog.example.com) to start connecting your own domain: the answer returns the CNAME target to put in that domain's DNS. If the blog or the domain step fails after the profile was made, the error says so and names the profile: call create_profile again with the SAME `requestId` to finish, never with a new one (that would make a second profile).

requestId.description: Any id you make up for this call, like a UUID. Required: it is what stops a lost answer from making a second profile. Send the same one to retry or to finish a blog that stopped halfway

about.description: What the brand is and does, in a few sentences

primaryColor.description: The main brand colour, like #1b6ef3. Default #141414

language.description: One of pt-BR, en, es. Default: the Espaço's language

handle.description: The name this profile answers to in SmartGenius (a-z, 0-9, dots, underscores). Default: made from `name`. It is not an Instagram @

links.description: The brand's website, Instagram and other links (up to 6). SmartGenius takes the logo from them, and its first read of the profile uses them to learn the brand

ownerProfile.description: Another profile in this Espaço that runs the blog, so its pages say "a blog by <that profile>". Default: this profile

customHost.description: Your own domain for the blog: www.example.com or blog.example.com

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read one profile: its name, language and time zone, its Instagram connection, and what SmartGenius learned from reading its posts. `instagram.connected` is false until someone connects the account in the studio. `needsReconnect` means the connection broke and a person has to connect it again there. `canReadInsights` says whether per-post numbers can be read (see list_media). `canPublish` and `publishingEnabled` say whether a post could go out from this account at all. `learned` holds the subjects it posts about (each with a weight from 0 to 1), the tone of its captions, its cadence (posts a week, and the weekdays and hours it posts most, hours in `timezone`) and the hashtags it uses most, as of `scannedAt`. It only reads.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List a profile's posts, newest first, with where each one stands and when it goes or went out. `status` is draft, ready (approved), scheduled, publishing, published or failed. Pass `status` to keep only some: `["scheduled"]` is what is booked to go out. `q` searches the title, the caption and the idea. Pages of `limit` posts from `offset`; `total` counts every match. Discarded posts are left out. Read one in full with get_post. It only reads.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

status.description: Keep only posts in these states. Default: every state

q.description: Words from the post's title, caption or idea

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List the profile's own Instagram posts, newest first, as SmartGenius has stored them: the kind, when it went out, its link, the start of its caption, what SmartGenius saw in its pictures (`subjects`) and its `numbers` (reach, saved, shares, likes, comments, totalInteractions, and views for reels) as of `numbersAt`. `numbers` is null for a post whose numbers were never read: they are read for the newest posts, and only while the connection allows it (`canReadInsights` in get_profile). `madeHere` and `postId` mark a post made in SmartGenius. `connected` false means the profile has no working Instagram connection, and the list is empty. `filling` means older posts are still being copied in. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. It only reads, and asks Instagram nothing.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

tools.name: list_suggestions
tools.description: List what the profile's own posts and numbers suggest doing next, strongest first. Each one has a `kind` and the measured `facts` behind it, never a sentence: `subject` (a subject it is known for, and the weeks since it last posted about it), `cadence` (posts a week, `was` in the month before last and `now` in the last month), `format` (`posts` it made without a single carousel), `repeat_winner` (a post about `subject` got `times` the profile's usual `metric`), `template` (its post patterns were drafted from less than SmartGenius can read now). `postId` is set once a suggestion became a post. `sourceMediaIds` are the Instagram media ids it was measured on. The list is measured again each time SmartGenius reads the profile. It only reads.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

tools.name: get_routine
tools.description: Read the profile's Autopilot: whether it is `on`, its posting times (`rules`), how a post goes out (`approval`: required waits for a person's ok, tacit goes out unless someone steps in, none goes out on its own, prepared `noticeHours` ahead), the saved ideas it uses first (`ideas`), its standing `instruction`, the next slots with what it would post in each (`preview`), the posts waiting for someone's ok (`waitingIds`), and `gate`, which says why it cannot run as set (null when it can). It only reads: changing Autopilot stays with a person in the studio.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

tools.name: get_instagram_connect_link
tools.description: Prepare a short-lived Instagram approval link for this profile, only when a person asks to connect or reconnect it. Admin only. Return the URL to that person; they must open it and approve on Meta. This call connects nothing, calls no external service and costs no credits. The URL expires at expiresAt and returns to this profile's Instagram screen in SmartGenius. Treat it as a private authorization link: never publish it. Approval can replace the current account, remove its imported history and cancel its schedules. Revoking the issuing API key stops new connections, not cleanup already started or connections already saved. Call again if it expires. It accepts no requestId or return URL, and its answer is not saved for replay. For another of a brand's Instagram accounts, pass that account's id from list_brands as `profile`.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID
